title: Épalinges — PDCom Cahier I diagnostic, 31 octobre 2022, approuvé avec réserve 5 juillet 2023

signed_approval.scope: Signed diagnostic Cahier I of the two-volume PDCom. Cantonal reservation concerns communal resizing principles in operational Cahier II chapter2.2 pages21–22, not diagnostic pages21–22. Approval does not make diagnostic figures binding private rights.
signed_approval.extraction_discrepancy: Existing embedded text reads council28September; original signed image visibly20September2022. Original text layer is preserved without silent correction.

reservations.literal_stamp: les principes communaux de redimensionnement de la zone d’habitation et mixte, tels qu’énoncés au chapitre 2.2 (pages 21 et 22).
reservations.interpretation: The stamp itself does not name a Cahier; matching chapter2.2 content and pages21–22 identifies operational CahierII, not diagnostic CahierI.
reservations.scope: Communal principles for resizing residential and mixed zones, operational Cahier II chapter2.2 pages21–22. Not diagnostic Cahier I pages21–22. Future PGA revision determines affected parcels; no current parcel entitlement or capacity claim.
